CI on PR #99 head (run 43297754699) fails client-test: launcher tests now see the built-in clocks in recorded positions, e.g. tests/launch/test_queue.py:217 expects checkpoint.at == {"steps": 3} and gets running_hours/hours_since_start too; tests/launch/test_runpod_machines.py:519 status.clocks == {"steps": 3}; a continuation test expects {"steps": 7}. Decide whether built-in clocks belong in launcher status/continuation positions (a continuation `until` names one clock); fix code or tests accordingly, and run the launch tests before publishing.
